positive_cases.name: component_registration_remote
positive_cases.scenario: Component registration utility pointed at a synthetic remote location.
positive_cases.rationale: Utility image and remote scheme selections both match.

positive_cases.name: script_host_remote
positive_cases.scenario: Script host pointed at a synthetic remote location.
positive_cases.rationale: Utility image and remote scheme selections both match.

negative_cases.name: local_component_registration
negative_cases.scenario: Component registration utility used against a local library.
negative_cases.rationale: Utility matches but there is no remote scheme.

negative_cases.name: browser_opens_url
negative_cases.rationale: Remote scheme matches but the image is not a script-capable utility.

negative_cases.name: script_host_local_file
negative_cases.scenario: Script host executes an approved local inventory script.
negative_cases.rationale: Utility matches but the argument is a local path.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
